input.summary: Make the Section 13.4 cap mutual and based on 12 months' fees, and add carve-outs for indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence and willful misconduct.
input.comment: [Playbook] We made the Section 13.4 cap mutual and aligned it to twelve months' fees rather than a three-month, M&I-only limit, and we placed indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence and willful misconduct outside the cap. This is our fallback position on limitation of liability.

ops.oldText: M&I's total liability under this Agreement shall not exceed payments made to M&I by Customer under this Agreement during the three (3) months prior to the event.
ops.newText: each party's total liability under this Agreement shall not exceed the fees paid or payable to M&I by Customer under this Agreement during the twelve (12) months prior to the event.

ops.text: The limitation of liability in the first sentence of this Section 13.4 shall not apply to a party's indemnification obligations under Section 14.2, breach of its confidentiality obligations under Section 17, gross negligence, or willful misconduct.
